mechanism_claims.claim_text: P9 antimicrobial activity is linked to α-helical structure under low-salt/membrane-mimetic or stapled conditions; unmodified P9 loses activity in physiologic-salt RPMI.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CXCL10-derived peptide P9 and engineered P9 variants
direct_assay_types: bacterial viability assays in Kph buffer/RPMI/DMEM
mechanism_claims.limitations: Membrane interaction is inferred from CD/liposome and salt-dependence evidence; no direct membrane permeabilization assay for isolated P9 variants is reported here.
